summary: ParaZero Technologies filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, attaching a press release dated September 15, 2026, announcing a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with ThirdEye Systems Ltd. (TASE: THES). The MOU covers joint exploration, integration, and commercialization of a combined detect-to-defeat Counter-UAS architecture pairing ThirdEye's electro-optical detection with ParaZero's DefendAir net-based physical interception, initially targeting armored vehicle platforms. No price, stake, premium, financing, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. No definitive agreement exists; execution of definitive documentation remains a condition, making this a routine commercial announcement.
